title: Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 34 (NeurIPS 2021)

pages.numbering: One-based physical PDF pages, matching printed page numbers. Partial first/last pages and section exclusions use exact substrings.

extractor: Poppler pdftotext 26.03.0, -raw, default UTF-8 and page breaks

extraction_segments.label: Complete Section 2: method, step-size choice, and market-volatility experiment
extraction_segments.start: 2 Adapting conformal inference to distribution shifts

extraction_segments.label: Complete Sections 4-6: coverage analysis, score-design sensitivity, and election experiment
Separately located limitations: entire Section 7 (limitations-only discussion)

selection_policy: Concatenate the three unchanged raw byte slices in paper order without adding separators. Include all main-body analysis, experiments, captions, footnotes, assumptions, comparisons, and negative/sensitivity findings. Exclude Abstract, Introduction (including 1.1), Related Work, acknowledgements, and references. Section 7 contains limitations rather than a summary conclusion and is retained in full.
word_count_method: Whitespace-separated tokens in the selected raw text; mathematical tokens and figure labels are included.
source_warnings: The proceedings PDF contains 13 pages; separately linked supplementary material is not part of this saved PDF and was not downloaded or included.
Section 2.2 explicitly states that four displayed stocks were chosen from twelve because the fixed-alpha comparator clearly failed; the complete statement is retained.
The election experiment replicates drift through time-zone ordering and random order within zones, rather than claiming to replay the actual reporting sequence; the full design is retained.
extraction_warnings: Raw extraction contains font-encoding artifacts, missing mathematical operators/step-size glyphs, misplaced mathematical tokens, and compressed spacing. No OCR, normalization, equation repair, or source rewriting was performed.
Figures 1-3 are preserved through all extractable labels and captions; raster/visual curves are available only in the saved PDF. No main-body tables were found.
Section 1.1 and its Equation (1), although relevant background for CQR, are excluded because they are inside Introduction; later references to that setup remain unchanged.
The input retains incidental page numbers and form feeds inside selected slices. The last page footer and acknowledgements are excluded by the exact final boundary.
